title: The Insane Story Behind the Last Car Enzo Ferrari Approved
description:
In nineteen eighty-seven, Ferrari unveiled a car that broke almost every rule of the road car. No door handles. No carpets. No sound system. It was the last Ferrari approved by Enzo Ferrari himself, and it was built in thirteen months. This is the story of the F forty, from a cancelled racing category to a car that now sells for millions. The story starts with a car that was never allowed to race. It involves a rivalry with Porsche, a deadline set by a man in his late eighties, a car that was planned for four hundred buyers and built for over thirteen hundred, and speculators who sold cars at seven times the list price. We will tell it in order, and say where our sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
